**Average (median) house price in California (2024)**  
- **Median listing price:** ≈ $800 000 USD  
- **Average (mean) price:** ≈ $850 000 USD  

> *Sources:*  
> • Zillow Research – “California Home Prices” (2024)  
> • Redfin Market Trends – “California Housing Market” (2024)  

**Key take‑aways**

| Region | Median price (2024) | Notes |
|--------|---------------------|-------|
| San Francisco Bay Area | $1.5 M+ | Highest in the state |
| Los Angeles County | $900 k–$1.2 M | Wide variation by city |
| Central Valley | $400 k–$600 k | More affordable |
| Inland Empire | $500 k–$700 k | Growing market |
| Northern California (excluding Bay Area) | $600 k–$800 k | Steady demand |

> The figures above reflect the **median** price, which is the most commonly cited metric for “average” house price. The **mean** price is slightly higher because a few very expensive properties pull the average up.  

If you need a more precise estimate for a specific city or ZIP code, let me know and I can pull the latest local data.
